title: Weight of balanced ternary representation of n
notes: W(n) for n≥0 is the number of nonzero balanced-ternary digits. Recurrences a(3n)=a(n), a(3n+1)=a(n)+1. Ruskey–Sawada treat the nonzero-count analogue c_k of the digit sum. The integer iteration of W is a digital-root analogue with attractor {0,1,2}; it is the control target of docs/problems/balanced_ternary_weight_dynamics.md.
